## Summary

**MOVE** (Move).

## Details

| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| Operation | `Bn → <ea>` |
| Syntax | `MOVE Bn,<ea>`<br>`MOVEA <ea>,Bn` (next page in the original) |
| Description | Move B-address register into destination. |
| Condition codes | see table |

### Condition codes

| X | N | Z | V | C |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| – | * | * | 0 | 0 |

### Encoding

| Word | Bits | Content |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | 15–12 | `0001` |
| 1 | 11–9 | Register |
| 1 | 8–6 | Mode |
| 1 | 5–3 | `001` |
| 1 | 2–0 | Bn |

- Size is long. Can be banked so &lt;ea&gt; includes En.
- &lt;ea&gt; does not allow An (or Bn)

### Example

```asm
    move.l    b0,d1
```

```text
bn b0: .. .. .. .. 00 12 34 56
Result:
ea d1: .. .. .. .. 00 12 34 56
```

## Differences from AmigaOS / AROS / 68060

- The 68000–68060 have MOVE. This page covers only the 68080 addition: MOVE with a B address register as source. For the classic forms, the Motorola manual applies.

## Do / Don't

- DON'T use An or Bn as the destination `<ea>`.
